SELECT 'sales' t, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d2, min(etl_loaded_at) mn, max(etl_loaded_at) mx FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2025-01-27' AND '2025-04-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ret', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), count(DISTINCT (sales_line_id, return_date, quantity_returned)), NULL, NULL FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN '2025-01-27' AND '2025-04-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'prodver', count(*), count(DISTINCT sku), count(DISTINCT product_key), NULL, NULL FROM dim_product
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sales_days_before', count(*), count(DISTINCT sale_date), 0, min(sale_date), max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2025-01-27' AND '2025-04-27'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.cost) AS cost, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4 AND cs.region = 'South'
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 14

SELECT 'sales' t, count(*) n,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_cost,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zero_cost,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos_qty,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.standard_cost - f.quantity*p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cost_mismatch,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.standard_cost - f.quantity*p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.02 THEN f.standard_cost - f.quantity*p.standard_unit_cost ELSE 0 END) mismatch_amt,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount < f.standard_cost THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) below_cost,
  count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-01-27' AND '2025-04-27' AND cs.region='South'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', count(*), sum(CASE WHEN r.standard_cost_returned IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), sum(CASE WHEN r.standard_cost_returned<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), sum(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(r.standard_cost_returned - r.quantity_returned*p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0, 0, count(DISTINCT s.store_id)
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN '2025-01-27' AND '2025-04-27' AND cs.region='South'

WITH mine AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) gross_net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-01-27' AND '2025-04-27' AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1),
ret AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) rn FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN '2025-01-27' AND '2025-04-27' AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1),
rpt AS (
  SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) b, sum(returns_net) rr, sum(net_sales) ns FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2025-01-27' AND '2025-04-27' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT cs.region, rpt.store_id, mine.gross_net, rpt.b, mine.gross_net-rpt.b d_before, ret.rn, rpt.rr, ret.rn-rpt.rr d_ret, mine.gross_net-ret.rn-rpt.ns d_net
FROM rpt LEFT JOIN mine USING(store_id) LEFT JOIN ret USING(store_id) JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=rpt.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE cs.region='South' OR abs(mine.gross_net-rpt.b)>1 OR abs(mine.gross_net-ret.rn-rpt.ns)>1
ORDER BY 1,2

  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-01-27' AND '2025-04-27' AND cs.region='South' AND p.category<>'ZZ Test')
SELECT 'all' k, count(*) n, sum(n) net, sum(c) cost, count(DISTINCT sku) skus FROM l

SELECT 'with_current', count(*), sum(n), sum(c), count(DISTINCT l.sku) FROM l JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=l.sku AND cp.is_current
